chunks: 1535 - And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, he said:
"Recite in the Salat of Jaʿfar عليه السلام

key_terms.جَعْفَرٍ: Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, to whom this prayer is attributed

ai.seo_question: Which surahs should be recited in the Salat of Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs which surahs are to be recited in the Salat of Jaʿfar عليه السلام. It indicates a specific recommended liturgical practice, pairing Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ and Sūrat al-Kāfirūn in this prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1535 - In a narration from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Imam Al-Sadiq (as),
Imam (as) said: "Recite in the Salat of Ja'far (as)
